x: Track Champion, Vic Stone, in the time of 55 mins. 43 secs., with Eric Hall 3rd and Fred Rolfe 16th. A fortnight later Beecham and Hall were again 2nd and 3rd in the Surrey W.C. race at Tooting Bec with H.

We managed to enter a team in this event, in which Norman Guilmant showed that he is still improving, when he finished 2nd to Vic Stone. Backed up by Harry Shields, Bernard Eglington and Alan Robins, we managed to finish 2nd to Poly., being only 3 points behind.
Hubbard 2nd in 4.13.38 and Vic Stone 3rd in 4.15.10. At one time they were both within 200 yards of George but his strength over the windswept Barham Downs told its tale and he gradually got away.

… selected to represent Great Britain in this Inter-national walking race of just over 60 miles, his co-competitor being Vic Stone of the Poly H. whilst our old friend "Timber" Woodcock of Surrey W.C. accompanied them as Manager and we are indebted to the latter for this report on the race.…
George Checkley passed Vic Stone in torrential rain to finish 7th, Norman was 10th, Harry 20th closely followed by Bob Newson who had recovered over the last lap to finish 22nd.

Ron West, our second claim member, had moved into the lead but was passed close home by Vic Stone who won in 3hrs. 41m. 46s. Bernard Eglington home on leave from Germany, walked strongly to finish 4th in 3.45.40.

George Checkley who had started off at a very fast pace, second to Thompson, began to lose ground and when Crawley was reached had dropped back to fourth place, Vic Stone having gone up to 2nd and the Italian Resta 3rd.
